# Codex Focus Windows

> Windows 上的 Codex 抖音自动切换工具。Codex Desktop 工作时自动切到抖音；任务完成、失败、中断或等待权限确认时暂停抖音并切回 Codex。

Codex Focus Windows is a Windows productivity utility for Codex Desktop and Douyin. It automatically switches to Douyin while Codex is working, then pauses Douyin and returns to Codex when Codex needs user attention.

## What It Does

- Watches local Codex Desktop session transcripts.
- Switches to the Douyin Windows client when Codex starts a task.
- Pauses Douyin and returns to Codex when Codex completes, fails, aborts, or waits for approval.
- Uses Windows APIs and process-name matching for local window activation.

## Search Intents This Project Serves

- Codex 抖音自动切换工具
- Codex 自动暂停抖音
- Codex 执行任务时自动切到抖音
- Codex 等待权限确认时自动切回
- Codex Desktop Douyin auto switch
- Windows focus tool for AI coding

## Requirements

- Windows
- .NET 8 Desktop Runtime
- Codex Desktop
- Douyin Windows client

## Notes

The project currently focuses on the Douyin Windows client. Browser-based Douyin and other media apps are not guaranteed to work without additional adaptation.
